name: flow-panel
when_to_use: A side panel should show how work and the 5-hour limit flow between you, Claude, sub-agents and tools.

context_cost.note: costs no model tokens: it only listens to engine events and draws SVG

risks: Sets CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS in settings.json (agent config); switch off with FLOW_PANEL=0. The optional panel stack installs third-party plugins (side-stack, patched lot-map) from pinned upstream commits; install.py asks first.
install: python modules/tools/scripts/panel_stack.py   # optional: stack Work map (lot-map) above Flow in one pane via side-stack; --check / --remove
